why_agent_cannot: a wallet connection or signature is required
what_human_must_do: 1 Step 1 : Connect a wallet in the USD.AI app Open the USD.AI app and use Connect Wallet to sign in. The app's leaderboard shows Allo for Season 3.

2 Step 2 : Pick the airdrop side with sUSDai Mint USDai on the swap page , then stake it into sUSDai on the stake page . Staking sUSDai is the path the project ties to the airdrop; USDai alone leans toward the ICO. The docs list a 30-day redemption time for sUSDai, against instant for USDai.

3 Step 3 : Choose a strategy Holding USDai or sUSDai is the basic strategy. Curated LP vaults, Pendle liquidity, Pendle YT and YT locking add more Allo, and the project says higher-risk options move Alignment faster. The Allo points guide lists them.
4 Step 4 : Track Allo and Alignment Check your Allo and rank on the leaderboard and your positions under My Positions . Your Airdrop Alignment needs to stay above the average across users.
5 Step 5 : Claim CHIP when it is offered The Season 3 leaderboard carries a Claim CHIP button, and the app has a CHIP section . The project has not published a per-wallet amount.
